sermon.title: Deliverance - October 15, 2023
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: After worship and prayer, the message teaches that you don’t have to wait forever for deliverance. From 1 John 2, Exodus and John 8, it says God has seen our oppression, heard our cry and comes down to deliver, that the Son sets us free from sin now, and that like Israel at the Red Sea we must not quit following Christ.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: The service opens with worship songs (lyrics as captioned) before the message at about 36:57. He says God planned two years from Egypt to the promised land, citing Numbers 9:1; he cites Peter “chapter 2:18” (2 Peter 2:18–19). Place names near the Red Sea (Pi Hahiroth, Baal Zephon) were restored from caption errors.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Then He spoke a parable to them, that men always ought to pray and not lose heart, saying: “There was in a certain city a judge who did not fear God nor regard man. Now there was a widow in that city; and she came to him, saying, ‘Get justice for me from my adversary.’ And he would not for a while; but afterward he said within himself, ‘Though I do not fear God nor regard man, yet because this widow troubles me I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me.’ ” Then the Lord said, “Hear what the unjust judge said. And shall God not avenge His own elect who cry out day and night to Him, though He bears long with them? I tell you that He will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will He really find faith on the earth?”

faqs.question: What Will Rogers saying does he quote?
faqs.answer: Even if you’re on the right track, you’ll get run over if you just sit there.

faqs.question: What if I sin again an hour later?
faqs.answer: Come back to God and say you need to change, and keep doing that until pretty soon you are free.

faqs.question: How should we approach God in prayer?
faqs.answer: The Lord’s Prayer is a great model; it starts by giving praise, glory and honor to God, then the other things.

faqs.question: Does the speaker claim to understand everyone’s life?
faqs.answer: No; to someone who says Mike, you don’t understand, he says no, I don’t, but Christ does.

faqs.question: Why did God create the world?
faqs.answer: He says because He is looking for people who will love Him and decide they want to be with Him.

faqs.question: Are people a virus on the earth?
faqs.answer: That is not the way God sees us; everything was created for us so God could have people who decided to love Him.

faqs.answer: Coming in saying you hate that guy right there.
